messages:
rahul_support: FYI — Coriant trial ingest failing during onboarding. Customers hit /v1/embeds -> 429 on bulk job. Errors started 10:05 PST. Need CS support + comms. Renewal flagged in 3 weeks. @zoe_cs @tom_csm

zoe_cs: ACK. Can you paste minimal logs and the account id? I'll triage with customer and set expectations.

rahul_support: account: coriantsys-prod-21. Sample error:
```
2026-03-18T10:05:12Z ERROR 429 TooManyRequests embed-batch: size=500
trace: retry exhausted
```
We see spike when they upload a 10k record CSV via our batch endpoint. They were onboarding from Azure region eu-west-1.

leah_se: Quick thought — if it's batching size causing rate limits, ask them to reduce batch_size to 100 and stagger. Temporary patch: set customer routing to dedicated-small for next 24h? @mike_eng can we open a short hotspot?

mike_eng: I can patch routing but need approval. Creating incident and spike window. Repro steps look consistent — KV cache pressure + continuous batching. I'll push a routing override to dedicated for coriantsys-prod-21 for 12h. ETA ~20m.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-20260318-451 (link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260318-451)

tom_csm: Thanks. CS comms plan (proposal):
- Immediate: reach out to customer with apology + workaround (reduce batch, retry logic) — zoe will send in 30m.
- Short-term (24h): routing override + monitor; offer engineer pairing session to re-upload small batches.
- If unresolved by EOD: schedule executive brief + credit discussion to address renewal anxiety.
I'll draft a message. @zoe_cs you good to own send?

zoe_cs: I'll own the customer message. Draft below, please review:
"Hi Ana — we see your bulk upload hit our rate limits; temporary workaround: reduce CSV chunk size to 100 rows and retry every 30s. We've enabled a routing override on our side while we monitor. I'll schedule a pairing session to re-upload and confirm success. — Zoe"

leah_se: Approve. Also add: mention we can run a one-off ingest via dry-run tool — saves time.

mike_eng: Routing override applied to coriantsys-prod-21 -> dedicated-small, started 10:45 PST. Monitoring for errors now. Rolling window 12h, auto-revert at 22:45 PST.

rahul_support: Confirmed reduced 429s at 10:52 PST. Two errors remaining for specific rows — sending sample to Zoe.

zoe_cs: Sending message now. I'll CC support and schedule pairing for 11:30 PST. I'll update this thread with customer reply.

rahul_support: Customer replied: "appreciate the fast response — we'll try chunking. Need ETA on permanent fix." They sound calmer but flagged renewal concern. Recommend follow-up next week to check performance.

tom_csm: Action items:
1) Zoe: send message + pairing (in progress)
2) Mike: monitor + extend override if needed (watch 12h)
3) Leah: prepare dry-run intake
4) Rahul: log detailed error rows in ticket
I'll own renewal flag — will schedule mid-week check-in with the account owner.

zoe_cs: Update: pairing done, all records ingested successfully. Customer asked for a permanent mitigations roadmap. I'll sync with Leah + Mike and prepare a short doc for them by Friday.

mike_eng: Keeping monitor. No regressions last 2h. Will follow up if traces show KV pressure.

rahul_support: Thanks all. Noting next steps in INC-20260318-451. :thumbsup:
